claims.assertion: Mari says years immersed in Earth culture gave some Toleka crew more human needs, including Earth food and social interaction; she cannot digest many Taygetan plants and sugars.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: Mari describes supply runs as military missions by Hashmallim and Shinonim, using fighter craft, concealed equipment, human vehicles, and night landings.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: Mari says returned vehicles and supplies are inspected and cleaned to prevent introducing seeds, spores, or animals aboard; she cites a spider and frog found on ships.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

coverage_gaps: Other logistics, safehouse and legal identity details omitted
